messages:
Maya Iyer: Quick alert  billing shows unexpected token counts for two customers yesterday evening. Looks correlated with a spike in 429 retries. Can eng confirm if retries were double-billed?
Liam Chen: Which customers and time window?
Maya Iyer: HelioLabs and NimbusAI, between 19:10-19:28 UTC. Invoices 2025-11-25-HELIO & 2025-11-25-NIM.
Jenna Park: Support saw a bunch of client-side retries from SDK older than v1.8. The SDK used to resend the entire payload on 429 without idempotency header.
Priya Rao: If retries hit our ingress and generated separate billing events we could have counted them. Need to check request_id and idempotency keys in request logs vs billing events.
Alex Gomez: We emit billable_token events at two points: "ingest" and "finalize" for streaming flows. For non-idempotent retries both points can fire multiple times. We expected router to dedupe by request_id, but old SDKs didn't set it.
Liam Chen: Running a quick join of request_logs -> billing_events for HelioLabs now.
billing-bot: [automated] billing-runner job 2025-11-25 reported anomaly: rate_limit_retries > threshold for 19:00-20:00 UTC
Liam Chen: Output: HelioLabs had 92 retry requests where request_id=null, billed_tokens total 1,120,400 vs unique_request_tokens 872,300 -> delta 248,100. NimbusAI delta 87,900.
Maya Iyer: Priya, rough $ impact by tier? HelioLabs is custom tier (negotiated) but billing formula is standard gen tokens $0.00085/1k.
Priya Rao: HelioLabs delta $210.89, NimbusAI delta $74.82. Both < $500. Recommend auto-credit and add explanatory note.
Alex Gomez: Short-term fix: treat requests without request_id + HTTP 429 as potentially duplicate and mark billing events provisional. Longer-term: force SDK minimum version and reject non-idempotent retry patterns in ingress.
Jenna Park: I'll prepare a support message: "We detected duplicate billing from client retries; we've issued an adjustment and recommend upgrading SDK"
Maya Iyer: Action items: (1) Liam export per-customer CSV with billed vs unique counts (2) Priya prepare credit memos (3) Alex add provisional-bill flag + ingress validation (4) Support send notices. Finance to hold these invoices until backfill complete.
Liam Chen: CSV uploaded: /shared/finance/reconciliations/1769804820-retry-audit.csv (columns: customer, billed_tokens, unique_tokens, delta_tokens).
Priya Rao: Draft credit memos uploaded. Total impact small, proceeding with automated credits per policy.
Maya Iyer: thanks everyone. Closing after backfill run completes and support messages are sent. :white_check_mark:
